name: Dark Thaumaturgy (Fires of the Inferno) — 3 Advanced — Furnaces of Hell

system.description: An advanced version of Incinerate that engulfs many targets at once. Spend a Willpower Trait and make a mass Mental Challenge against Physical Traits, affecting as many targets as you have permanent Willpower Traits; anyone defeated suffers the effects of Incinerate, except the initial blast deals three levels of aggravated damage.
